text:
carla: Heads up — console is showing stale quota balances for a handful of tenants across eu-west. Noticed at 12:10 UTC. Looks like heartbeat for quota-collector shards dropped during last reassign.
kevin: which shards? got any tenant ids or screenshots?
carla: shard ids 47/51. tenant examples: ten_1234, ten_9987. screenshot: https://img.redwood/local/shot.png
maya: I saw a related spike in commit-latency when we rolled collector-v2 canary this morning. suspect lease handoff didn't finish -> missed heartbeats -> aggregation skipped.
alex: ops-bot reported a successful reassignment at 12:09:58, but there's a later error in the collector logs: `ERROR: lease renewal timeout for shard=47 tenant=ten_1234`
kevin: can you paste the tail of the collector log for shard 47? also check `quorum-state` in zookeeper.
carla: log snip: ```
2026-03-21T12:09:59Z WARN lease renew failed shard=47 err=ctx deadline exceeded
2026-03-21T12:10:02Z INFO attempting requeueing shard=47
2026-03-21T12:10:12Z INFO shard=47 assigned to node=collector-3
```
maya: so shard reassigned but some in-flight deltas weren't flushed to the ledger before handoff. aggregation window skips those -> console preview undercounts tokens.
alex: mitigation plan: 1) trigger `shard-resync --shard=47 --replay-unflushed` for the affected shards 2) patch collector to block reassignment until flush completes (hotfix) 3) mark affected tenants with a console annotation until resync completes.
carla: oncall @kevin can you run the resync for 47 and 51? prefer run during low-traffic window but fast fix appreciated.
kevin: doing it now, starting with shard=47. running: `./bin/shard-resync --shard 47 --tenant-pattern ten_*` will report back.
ops-bot: [12:11:05] Job queued: shard-resync job_id=jr_8843 triggered by kevin
kevin: resync complete for shard 47, replayed ~12k events, console balances updated for ten_1234 and ten_9987. running shard 51 next.
maya: for the hotfix I'll open a small PR to gate reassignment on `flush_complete` boolean. maybe feature flag for telemetry canary.
alex: good. can we add a console UX note that shows 'last resync' timestamp per tenant so customers can see when balances were backfilled?
carla: yes please — add a small badge in preview stating "last reconciliation" timestamp so support doesn't get pinged repeatedly.
kevin: shard 51 resync done too. monitoring for new anomalies for the next 2h.
carla: thanks all. followups: maya to PR hotfix, alex to spec console badge, kevin to verify rollbacks and file postmortem entries.
maya: on it. will include tests to simulate reassignment during heavy write.
alex: adding a stub in the runbook: `if quota-preview mismatch -> check shard leases -> resync shards -> annotate console`.
kevin: closing loop in ~2h if stable :thumbsup:
